releaseNotes:
The server now shows as iptv.cantostv.com, and Add Playlist starts with it filled in.

Every form field has a clear (X) button that empties it in one tap, and the sign-in screen has a show-password eye.

Signing out of Sync saves your library to your account and leaves this phone clean. Sign back in and it all comes back.

On Live TV, Movies and Series the search keyboard closes when you press Search, scroll the results or open a title.

Forgot password? now sends a CantosTV email.
